A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a logic for ER databases that has all of the desirable characteristics of FOL and that has the same capabilities as relational calculus, SQL and QBE.
ERL, ERRC, ERQBE, and ERSQL are the ER model counterparts of FOL, the relational calculus, QBE, and SQL, respectively.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the ER model is not only a useful tool for database design but also a powerful tool for database specification and implementation.
the ER model can be made as expressive and flexible as the relational model.
the ER model, which has been around for over 30 years, can now be considered a first class member of the family of relational database models.
